title: BatchMergeConfig
description: Schema contract for the BatchMergeConfig frozen dataclass governing batch vocabulary merge parameters.

deduplicate.description: Whether duplicate rows are deduplicated during batch merge operations.

deduplicate_by_lemma.description: Whether deduplication uses lemma-normalized keys rather than raw inflected forms.

sort_frequency.description: Whether merged output rows are sorted by word frequency descending.

combine_order.description: Order applied when combining source words in merged output (e.g. 'alphabetical', 'frequency').

prefer_lowercase.description: Whether combined or merged tokens prefer lowercase normalization.

apostrophe_chars.description: Characters treated as apostrophes during batch token boundary resolution. Must be a Unicode string.
